 Kemper (KMPR) Returns To Profit As Investors Ask If The Turnaround Is Already Priced In
 Mitch Lawler Sun, November 15, 2026 at 4:21 PM MST 4 min read KMPR -0.27%

 Learn more Kemper (KMPR) moved back into the spotlight after reporting third quarter results that showed net income of US$52.4 million, compared with a loss a year earlier, even as revenue slipped to US$1,090.6 million. 
 Kemper's recent quarter has arrived after a sharp short term rebound, with a 30 day share price return of 16.67% and a 90 day gain of 30.29%. However, the year to date share price return is still down 13.61%, and the 1 year total shareholder return has declined 7.07%. 
 Scan beyond Kemper and compare this earnings turnaround story with a curated 34 high quality undervalued stocks that combine improving profitability signals with balance sheets that may better support future shocks. 
 After a sharp rebound off the lows but weak multi year returns and a recent quarterly profit against a wider year to date loss, Kemper now sits at a crossroads. The key question for investors is whether the current valuation still skews the risk reward toward buyers. 
 Most Popular Narrative: 26% Overvalued 
 On the latest close of $34.15, the bearish analyst Narrative on Simply Wall St anchors Kemper's fair value near $27.00. This implies the recent rebound leaves the stock trading above that reference point and places more emphasis on a clean execution of the turnaround. 
 The numbers imply the current Kemper share price already reflects expectations for a successful turnaround. This is why this narrative views the stock as overvalued and vulnerable if profitability and growth do not improve. 
 The planned shift of Kemper's portfolio away from California personal auto toward Florida, Texas and commercial auto depends on profitable growth in those segments while absorbing a shrinking California book. 
 See why 1 investors see Kemper as 26% overvalued . 
 Result: Fair Value of $27.00 (OVERVALUED) 
 Still, if Kemper continues to move specialty auto underwriting closer to profitable levels and Kemper Life maintains steady income, this bearish narrative could soften quickly. 
 Find out about the key risks to this Kemper narrative . 
 Another View: What Kemper's Revenue Multiple Is Saying 
 The earlier bearish narrative leans on an earnings based fair value of $27.00, yet Kemper's current P/S of 0.5x tells a different story. The ratio sits well below both the US Insurance industry at 1.2x and peers at 2.6x, and even below a fair ratio estimate of 0.8x. 
 That discount can point to a margin of safety if profitability recovers. It can also signal that the market is bracing for weaker premium and earnings quality for longer than analysts model. The key question for you is whether this gap reflects caution that is justified or an opportunity that is being overlooked.

 Sentiment on Kemper is clearly mixed right now, with fresh profit, weaker long term returns and both risk and reward signals pulling in opposite directions.
